description: Throttle failed authentication attempts per IP and lock accounts after repeated failures.

maxAttempts.label: Max attempts
maxAttempts.description: Failed attempts allowed within the window before triggering throttle or lockout.

windowSeconds.label: Window (seconds)
windowSeconds.description: Time window during which failed attempts are counted.

lockoutDurationSeconds.label: Lockout duration (seconds)
lockoutDurationSeconds.description: Base lockout duration when the threshold is reached.

exponentialBackoff.label: Exponential backoff
exponentialBackoff.description: Extend the lockout exponentially on consecutive lockouts.

backoffMultiplier.label: Backoff multiplier
backoffMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to lockout duration when exponential backoff is on.
